verdict.rationale: The evidence gives only an aggregate claim of more than 25,600 conversions across more than 300 formats, plus a list of converter categories (image, presentation, font, ebook). Nothing shows a documented input-to-output pair matrix or lookup that would let a user check a specific pair before trying it, so the story's core capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power user, the tool documents which input formats convert to which outputs, so I can check a pair before trying it
